title: Which way does the pair push?
hook: Which way does a preferred pair push the model?

claims.text:
stage computation: Chosen A, rejected B, reference odds qA/qB=1. Policy log odds theta gives pA=sigmoid(theta). DPO pair loss L=−log sigmoid(beta*(theta−log(qA/qB))). Set beta1, theta0, learning rate1. Gradient theta=−.5, new theta=.5, pA=.6224593, loss .474077 from ln2.

**Countercase / boundary:** Swap chosen/rejected labels: gradient+.5, theta−.5,pA=.3775407. beta0 makes pair loss ln2 independent of theta and gradient0. This is one declared pair update, not a claim to recover uniquely correct human values or universal replacement of all RL.

**Prediction / transfer recall:** Predict direction of pA under the chosenA pair; recall unequal reference odds4 requires theta=ln4 for an initial zero preference log-ratio, not theta0.

**Intervention / reachable witness:** Update pair computes reference-normalized log ratio, loss, gradient and policy probability; Swap labels recomputes from same initialtheta while retaining both signed updates. Distinguish reference from policy, no hidden reward model.
